summary: Hancock Whitney Corp. filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, disclosing a definitive merger agreement to acquire OFB Bancshares, Inc. for $29.273 per share in cash. The transaction involves a two-step merger structure: OFB Bancshares first merges with a Hancock subsidiary, then into Hancock Whitney, followed by a bank-level merger of One Florida Bank into Hancock Whitney Bank. The boards of both companies approved the deal. The agreement includes customary representations, warranties, and covenants. The parties will seek regulatory and third-party consents. The risk-arb angle focuses on regulatory approval timeline and any potential appraisal rights exercised by OFB shareholders.
